$comment: MoOS shared MCP servers — see docs/MCP.md for what each one is for, which
credentials it needs, and how to set it up. Guarded by tests/test_mcp_config.py.
RULES FOR THIS FILE:
1. Never hardcode a credential here. This file is committed. Credentials come
from the environment as ${VAR}; a missing var is a warning, not a crash.
2. Every server added here must also be listed in .claude/settings.json under
enabledMcpjsonServers and permissions.allow, or every agent gets an approval
prompt on first use. The gate enforces this.
3. Keep the set SMALL. Every server's tools consume the agent's context budget.

sequential-thinking.$comment: Structured multi-step reasoning with revision and branching. No credentials.

$comment: Version-current documentation for the libraries this repo actually builds on:
Qt 6 / QML, KDE Plasma 6, Flutter/Dart, React 19, Vite, bootc, cosign, GitHub Actions.
Works anonymously; CONTEXT7_API_KEY only raises the rate limit.
A real Chrome the agent can drive, screenshot and profile. The reason it earns
its place here: moremote/controller is a real React 19 + Vite PWA, and the Mo
Remote surface is the one part of MoOS a browser can actually render. Also renders
artwork/*.svg contact sheets so a visual change can be SEEN, not inferred.
Needs a Chrome binary. Run `just mcp-setup` once — it installs one and points
MOOS_CHROME at it. Without that, the default path is where a system-wide Chrome
lives on Linux; the server still starts and reports a clear error if it is absent.
Usage statistics and CrUX URL reporting are both off: MoOS pages are not public.
Text-to-image and image-to-image editing (Gemini 'Nano Banana' by default,
OpenAI gpt-image with MOOS_IMAGE_PROVIDER=openai). For wallpapers, boot art,
hero plates and icon studies.
Output goes to a SCRATCH directory on purpose, NOT into the repo. A generated
image is a draft; it enters system_files/ only after a human has looked at it
and artwork/verify_visuals.py passes on it. Set MOOS_IMAGE_OUT to change.
Needs GEMINI_API_KEY — the server starts without one and fails only on use.
